```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(here)      # project root = GitInstrument/
library(lavaan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

# 1. Configuration

Item lists come from the shared file `phase2-2-item-reduction/item_versions_config.R`,
the same one used by `01_reliability/01_reliability.Rmd`.

The model specification is the same as in the old notebooks (`Reproduce3-MG-CFA-Model_1/2/3.Rmd`):

* multigroup CFA by `stimulus` (Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, Gephi, JMP);
* estimator ML (lavaan default), `missing = "fiml"`;
* one latent factor per scale, items as indicators.

```{r config}
source(here("phase2-2-item-reduction", "item_versions_config.R"))
cat("Versions:", paste(names(versions), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# indices reported in the paper table (Results Summary)
paper_indices <- c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "cfi", "tli", "rmsea",
                   "rmsea.ci.lower", "rmsea.ci.upper", "srmr", "ntotal", "npar")
```

# 2. Data and output folders

```{r data}
data_path <- here(params$data_file)
stopifnot(file.exists(data_path))
raw <- read.csv(data_path, encoding = "UTF-8", check.names = FALSE)

# drop the blank rows and make stimulus an explicit factor
grp_data <- raw %>% filter(!is.na(stimulus) & stimulus != "") %>% select(-seed)
grp_data$stimulus <- factor(grp_data$stimulus)
cat("N =", nrow(grp_data), "\n"); print(table(grp_data$stimulus))

all_items <- unique(unlist(lapply(versions, function(v) c(unlist(v$full), unlist(v$models)))))
missing <- setdiff(all_items, names(grp_data))
if (length(missing) > 0) stop("Items not found in data: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

out_root <- here("phase2-2-item-reduction", "02_cfa", "output")
dir.create(out_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("Output folder:", out_root, "\n")

writeLines(c(paste("data_file:", data_path),
             paste("md5:", tools::md5sum(data_path)),
             paste("run at:", Sys.time())),
           file.path(out_root, "run_info.txt"))
file.copy(here("phase2-2-item-reduction", "item_versions_config.R"), out_root, overwrite = TRUE)
```

# 3. Functions

```{r functions}
# write.csv that does not stop the knit when a file is locked (e.g. open in Excel):
# it writes a copy with a time stamp instead and warns.
safe_write_csv <- function(x, file, ...) {
  ok <- tryCatch({ write.csv(x, file, ...); TRUE }, error = function(e) FALSE)
  if (!ok) {
    alt <- sub("\\.csv$", paste0("_", format(Sys.time(), "%H%M%S"), ".csv"), file)
    write.csv(x, alt, ...)
    warning("Could not write ", basename(file), " (is it open in Excel?). Saved as ", basename(alt))
  }
  invisible(file)
}

model_syntax <- function(factors) {
  paste(sapply(names(factors), function(f)
    paste(f, "=~", paste(factors[[f]], collapse = " + "))), collapse = "\n")
}

# fit one multigroup CFA, capturing warnings instead of hiding them
fit_cfa <- function(factors, group.equal = "") {
  warns <- character(0)
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    cfa(model_syntax(factors), data = grp_data, group = "stimulus",
        missing = "fiml", group.equal = group.equal),
    warning = function(w) { warns <<- c(warns, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") })
  attr(fit, "warnings") <- warns
  fit
}

save_fit <- function(fit, version, model, out_dir) {
  # fitMeasures() of the full model is slow (FIML, many items, 5 groups): it is computed
  # once and stored with the cached fit (attribute "fm"), so later versions reuse it.
  fm <- attr(fit, "fm")
  if (is.null(fm)) fm <- fitMeasures(fit)
  m <- as.matrix(fm); colnames(m) <- model
  safe_write_csv(m, file.path(out_dir, paste0("fit_indices-", model, ".csv")))

  groups <- lavInspect(fit, "group.label")          # lavaan numbers the groups 1..5
  std <- standardizedSolution(fit) %>% filter(op == "=~")
  std$stimulus <- groups[std$group]                  # tool name of each group
  safe_write_csv(std, file.path(out_dir, paste0("std_loadings-", model, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  # latent factor correlations per tool (to inspect warnings such as a non positive definite matrix)
  cors <- lavInspect(fit, "cor.lv")
  cors <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cors), function(g) {
    cm <- cors[[g]]
    idx <- which(upper.tri(cm), arr.ind = TRUE)
    data.frame(stimulus = groups[g], factor_1 = rownames(cm)[idx[, 1]],
               factor_2 = colnames(cm)[idx[, 2]], correlation = cm[idx])
  }))
  safe_write_csv(cors, file.path(out_dir, paste0("factor_cor-", model, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  data.frame(version = version, model = model,
             converged = lavInspect(fit, "converged"),
             warnings = paste(unique(attr(fit, "warnings")), collapse = " | "),
             t(fm[paper_indices]), row.names = NULL)
}
```

# 4. Run everything

The full model is fitted once per structure (3-factor or 4-factor) and reused by every version
that shares it. Versions A–D share the 3-factor full model; Version E uses the 4-factor one.

```{r run}
full_fits <- list()
rows <- list()
invariance_rows <- list()

for (v in names(versions)) {
  cfg <- versions[[v]]
  out_dir <- file.path(out_root, v)
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # full model (cached by structure)
  key <- paste(names(cfg$full), sapply(cfg$full, length), collapse = "_")
  if (is.null(full_fits[[key]])) {
    full_fits[[key]] <- fit_cfa(cfg$full)
    attr(full_fits[[key]], "fm") <- fitMeasures(full_fits[[key]])   # computed once per structure
  }
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- save_fit(full_fits[[key]], v, "full_model", out_dir)

  # reduced models
  for (m in names(cfg$models)) {
    fit <- fit_cfa(cfg$models[[m]])
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- save_fit(fit, v, m, out_dir)

    if (params$invariance) {
      fit_metric <- fit_cfa(cfg$models[[m]], group.equal = "loadings")
      fit_scalar <- fit_cfa(cfg$models[[m]], group.equal = c("loadings", "intercepts"))
      lrt <- lavTestLRT(fit, fit_metric, fit_scalar)
      inv <- data.frame(version = v, model = m,
                        level = c("configural", "metric", "scalar"),
                        as.data.frame(lrt), row.names = NULL)
      inv <- cbind(inv, t(sapply(list(fit, fit_metric, fit_scalar),
                                 function(f) fitMeasures(f, c("cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr")))))
      safe_write_csv(inv, file.path(out_dir, paste0("invariance-", m, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
      invariance_rows[[length(invariance_rows) + 1]] <- inv
    }
  }
  cat("done:", v, "\n")
}

fit_long <- bind_rows(rows)
safe_write_csv(fit_long, file.path(out_root, "fit_all_versions_long.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
if (length(invariance_rows) > 0)
  safe_write_csv(bind_rows(invariance_rows), file.path(out_root, "invariance_all_versions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# models that did not converge or raised warnings
fit_long %>% filter(!converged | warnings != "") %>% select(version, model, converged, warnings)
```

# 5. Table in the same layout as "Results Summary"

One block per index; rows = model, columns = version.

```{r summary table}
fit_wide <- fit_long %>%
  select(version, model, chisq, df, pvalue, cfi, tli, rmsea, srmr) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(chisq, df, pvalue, cfi, tli, rmsea, srmr), names_to = "index") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(index = factor(index, levels = c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "tli", "cfi", "rmsea", "srmr")),
         model = factor(model, levels = c("full_model", "Model_1", "Model_2", "Model_3"))) %>%
  arrange(index, model)
safe_write_csv(fit_wide, file.path(out_root, "fit_summary_wide.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(fit_wide, digits = 3)

# Paper table (LaTeX): one block per fit index; rows = model, columns = version
idx <- c(chisq = "$\\chi^2$ (df)", cfi = "CFI ($\\geq$ 0.95)", tli = "TLI ($\\geq$ 0.95)",
         rmsea = "RMSEA ($\\leq$ 0.06)", srmr = "SRMR ($\\leq$ 0.08)")
mod_order <- c("full_model", "Model_1", "Model_2", "Model_3")
mod_label <- c(full_model = "Baseline", Model_1 = "Model 1", Model_2 = "Model 2", Model_3 = "Model 3")
fl <- as.data.frame(fit_long)
vers <- sort(unique(fl$version))
cellf <- function(ix, r) {
  if (nrow(r) == 0) return("--")
  if (ix == "chisq") sprintf("%.1f (%d)", r$chisq[1], as.integer(r$df[1])) else sprintf("%.3f", r[[ix]][1])
}
body <- character(0)
for (ix in names(idx)) {
  for (k in seq_along(mod_order)) {
    m <- mod_order[k]
    cells <- vapply(vers, function(v) cellf(ix, fl[fl$version == v & fl$model == m, , drop = FALSE]), "")
    body <- c(body, paste0(if (k == 1) idx[[ix]] else "", " & ", mod_label[[m]], " & ",
                           paste(cells, collapse = " & "), " \\\\"))
  }
  body[length(body)] <- paste(body[length(body)], "\\hline")
}
fit_tex <- c("% Generated by phase2-2-item-reduction/02_cfa/02_cfa.Rmd -- do not edit by hand",
             "% Needs \\usepackage{graphicx} (\\resizebox)",
             "\\begin{table}[htbp]", "\\centering", "\\small",
             paste0("\\caption{Global fit of the multigroup CFA (five tools, FIML, collapsed data) by model and version. ",
                    "Baseline: the 49 items that started the item reduction phase (Versions A--D) and the 61 items ",
                    "of the four-factor structure (Version E). A model meets the fit rule when (CFI or TLI $\\geq$ 0.95) and ",
                    "(SRMR $\\leq$ 0.08 or RMSEA $\\leq$ 0.06); the cutoff of each index is shown next to it. ",
                    "-- = model not defined for the version.}"),
             "\\label{tab:fit-summary}",
             "\\resizebox{\\linewidth}{!}{%",
             paste0("\\begin{tabular}{ll", strrep("r", length(vers)), "}"), "\\hline",
             paste0("Index & Model & ", paste(sub("Version_", "Version ", vers), collapse = " & "), " \\\\"),
             "\\hline", body, "\\end{tabular}}", "\\end{table}")
writeLines(fit_tex, file.path(out_root, "fit-summary-table.tex"))
```
